conclusion.verified: exact arm indexed_vectors=0; hnsw arm indexed_vectors=2069/2069, status green
conclusion.interpretation: At 2,069 points with m=16 and ef_construct=100 the HNSW graph is small enough that traversal is effectively exhaustive, so approximate search returns the same top-60 as a full scan. This does NOT show that approximate search is free at 100k points - it shows the recall cliff is beyond this corpus size, which is a narrower and honest claim.
conclusion.latency: Not measurable here. Search round-trips to managed Qdrant averaged ~290 ms in both modes, dominated by network latency to the cloud region rather than by search itself. A meaningful latency comparison needs a local instance.
conclusion.standing_config: HNSW left enabled (indexing_threshold=1000 KB) - identical quality, and the code path a larger corpus would use.
conclusion.caveat: indexing_threshold controls index BUILDING, not use. Raising it does not restore exact search; that needs a collection rebuild.
